method: Assistant review of final exported statements and structured fields against the 19 predeclared source facts. Evidence quotations alone do not count as extraction. F=fully represented for this checklist item, P=partially represented, M=missing, E=present with a material unsupported addition. This is a limited, non-blinded factual checklist, not a general precision/recall score or an independent expert review. Ontology fit and relationships require separate assessment.
